verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents generic contract creation (no-code builder), workflow launch and signing (ironclad-docs-9, -10, -16, -38), which could carry hiring agreements. One community user reports onboarding new contractors through Ironclad with a button click (ironclad-comm-6). Nothing ties the platform specifically to offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements or equity grants. Missing for 10: documented offer-letter templates or workflows, confidentiality/IP assignment agreement support, option-grant/equity paperwork support, and current first-party evidence of HR/equity use cases.
